items.title: Wheat Embroidery Coloring Illustration
items.alt: Two hands with closed sleeve cuffs hold a round embroidery hoop with a stitched wheat-ear motif and guide a needle through its fabric.
items.description: Two hands with closed sleeve cuffs hold a round embroidery hoop with a stitched wheat-ear motif and guide a needle through its fabric. The needle, hoop and closed cuffs suit a personal embroidery-themed coloring page.

items.description: Two young wheat plants grow in a clear rectangular container with visible roots along its wall, beside a complete magnifying glass. The visible roots and magnifier suit a classroom plant-observation coloring activity.
